events.note: NASA global P1 07:30:00.3 UT, printed with ΔT 84.8 s. The penumbra covers the Atlantic at sunrise, Europe, Africa and the Middle East, and leaves Earth (P4 12:42:59.6 UT) before it reaches North America's daylit side. USNO's solar eclipse API returned HTTP 500 for every 2027 date on the retrieval date, so NASA's map is the authority here
